scope: Proposition 4.1 (Arch formula) of the manuscript “Critical strip-crossing mass on the honeycomb lattice” (preprints/Critical-strip-crossing-mass-on-the-honeycomb-lattice-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 33e92f50d83f5343), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 13-14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
